name: API Lessons
description:
A comprehensive list of free, short Lightning Lessons on the Maven education platform by Emmanuel Paraskakis. The topics covered are APIs, MCP, Product Management, Technical PM Careers, and MCP Apps.
Users can either view a recording, sign up for an upcoming live lesson, or learn which cohort-based course/workshop is connected to the topic so they can go deeper into it.
Lightning Lessons are conducted over Zoom and are practical and hands-on with skills you can use immediately. They are meant for tech-savvy mid-career professionals, especially those in the technology or software industry. They are conducted exclusively in the English language.
The main Instructor is Emmanuel Paraskakis, an entrepreneur, product management executive, and consultant at Level 250 with over 15 years of experience shaping products.

tool.name: getLessons
tool.title: Get Lessons
tool.description: Use this tool to search for short lessons on APIs, MCP, Product Management, Technical PM Careers, and ChatGPT Apps. Lessons are either available On Demand (watch the recording) or Scheduled (sign up for upcoming live training). DO NOT use if they are looking for education topics outside software, technology, or business. How it works: a partial text search returns matching lessons with full details including title, description, learning outcomes, instructor, guest speakers, related course, and signup URL. The search covers all of these fields. Supports broad queries like "all" or "every" as well as specific topic searches.

_published_faq.name: How do I add API Lessons to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add API Lessons to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ll-mcp.replit.app/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is API Lessons MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, API Lessons scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is API Lessons's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, API Lessons scores 91/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 1 of 1 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the API Lessons MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: API Lessons provides these MCP tools: getLessons.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to API Lessons?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to API Lessons in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.

_published_faq.name: Does API Lessons MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: API Lessons does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
API Lessons is developed by Level 250, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
